signin.errors.generic: We could not sign you in. Try again.
signin.subtitle: Owner access to {{name}}'s journal
recovery.title: Forgot your password?
recovery.description: Get back into your journal with a recovery code, an email link or the server.
recovery.sent: If this email belongs to the owner, you will receive a recovery link. Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires in 15 minutes.
recovery.error: We could not complete recovery. Try again or use server recovery.
recovery.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
recovery.serverDescription: If Google is unavailable, email is not configured, or you signed up with a username, open an interactive terminal in your Blogram project on the server and run:
recovery.serverHint: Enter your database connection URL, then choose and confirm a new password. Inputs are hidden. Type RESET to confirm. All sessions will close; your posts and settings are kept. Only someone with server and database access can do this.
recovery.resetDescription: Choose a new password for your owner account.
recovery.invalid: This recovery link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.
recovery.success: Your password has been reset and previous sessions have been closed. Sign in with your new password.
recovery.identifierHint: Forgot your username? After resetting with a recovery code we show you the name to sign in with.
recovery.codes.title: Recovery codes
recovery.codes.description: Single-use codes that reset your password if you forget it, without email or Google. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
recovery.codes.none: You have no recovery codes yet. Generate them now so you can always get back in.
recovery.codes.exhausted: You have used all your recovery codes. Generate new ones.
recovery.codes.replaceHint: New codes replace the current ones, which stop working.
recovery.codes.saveNow: Save these codes now. They will not be shown again, and each one works once.
recovery.codes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes and copy them manually.
recovery.codes.fileTitle: Blogram recovery codes. Each code works once.
recovery.codes.error: We could not generate the codes. Try again.
recovery.codes.useDescription: Enter one of the codes you saved in Account › Security, then choose a new password.
recovery.codes.invalid: This recovery code is not valid or was already used.
recovery.codes.success: Your password has been reset and every session has been closed.
